note: Triennial election, polled on Thursday 5 June 1952. Only Dunadry and Donegore were contested (held). The Ballymena Observer names two divisions with new (unopposed) representatives; the other uncontested members are not named in the sources found. New representative taking the place of James Moody; not contested, so returned unopposed. Returned unopposed. Uncertain: unopposed inferred from 'will have new representatives' + two-contest statement.
